gen-gf-gugi-fs-trench-slab: Gugi's tall lowercase nearly climbs to its capitals. Trench Slab, a text serif, answers that wire-like single line with dignified, tightly set letters that make the heading feel even bolder.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-domine: Bold and distinctive, Gugi draws every curve and diagonal with the same heft as its stems. Domine follows with serif refinement, where heavy stems ease into lighter curves, giving the pair a dignified backbone.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-esteban: Gugi's most striking habit is curves and straights sharing a single width, with open terminals that let counters flow outward. And Esteban, a text serif, narrows gradually from stem to terminal, so a long passage feels classic and unhurried.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-faustina: Gugi sets a bold, distinctive heading where diagonals weigh as much as the verticals, with lowercase reaching nearly to the capitals. Faustina, a text serif, adds mild stroke contrast.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-halant: Halant reads as authoritative and traditional, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones, with terminals pointing outward. Gugi above it bends like wire signage, constant in thickness.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-headland-one: Headland One reads as traditional and dignified, a classic serif with gentle stroke variation and letters set well apart. But Gugi is the one with the round bowls whose outline never swells or thins, which gives the headings their bold, signlike punch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Gugi leads with distinctive, bold forms whose outline stays steady and unshaded from start to finish. And Hedvig Letters Serif, a text serif, tapers its joins modestly and keeps open curves with room to breathe.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC is dignified, a text serif with gentle modulation and terminals pulled well back. Gugi earns its keep big and short, where its constant, blueprint-like line can show off.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-montagu-slab: Blunt and blueprint-plain up top, with zero modulation in the line. And Montagu Slab, a text serif, shifts its weight only slightly, like stretched rubber cord, so the two sit comfortably on one page.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Gugi draws curves and stems without any thick-thin pulse, tall lowercase nearly meeting its capitals. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a classic serif, thickens gently at the shoulders, and that quiet modulation is the pair's strongest quality.
